Require child success, Job closure, ACL/profile/session cleanup and all artifacts accepted. No output writes after authoritative acceptance. A resource/transport/cleanup/semantic failure receives its actual recorded outcome, not a rerun.

Never stage them or include them in executable code, prompt, grammar, candidate construction or contained inputs. Report emitted/selected/unique accepted/correct/expected counts, source-native precision null if none, coverage zero if none, absent/null correctness and canonical marker/link behavior. Empty valid responses get zero selected/accepted coverage. Parser-copied facts and controller-forced identities/states/citations/no-target markers earn no learned semantic/relevance accuracy. Selected-ID coverage alone is not independent relevance, association, generalization or operational accuracy.
